content: 2:1-7 Maria Yisas baurei
Qen end Rom gabman munon aib wurinou gigit igoar eng unum Sisar Ogastus. Wo munon ginam gugum isub unum bigar qamb qob biga ginam-ginam isorei.

Qen qamart munon gugum isub unum bigar qamb ebetemir eng Kwirinius wo Siria provins wurinou gabman igoai. Kwirinius wo ende igama munon gugum ginam qenen wogub iua ginam taut igour end bo wurinou ginam qenen end isub unum bigar qamb.
Ende isub igamari ne Yosep wo ai Galili ginam Nasaret end igoar eng wogub wo Debit tumbigi end ai Yudia end isub is ginam qoan Debit unor bauor end isorei, ginam eng unum Betlehem.

Wo gor unum gumaib isiba ne Maria wo bai qamb maribigumir end nob isorei. Qen end Maria wo qurag igoai. Wuri Betlehem end isari Maria wau baib ebeter eng wuri munai inau ue. Ende gab ne wai wurinou munai end inemirei. Inemirei igo itum end Maria wau qamar baurei. Baub wogub mingoant ouri wogub bur qarig mi nub igour tabin end biga inab igoai.
2:8-14 Enger munon wai sipsip oroar igour eng qob wurinob qamarei
Qen end munon qei wai sipsip itum oroar ai end gari igeragart end igurei.
Igamari Munon Aib wonou enger dara begen qiribiten qenenginob wurit arirama gab borusi qiet yariamirei.
Ne enger der wurinob qamar: “Me yarimar, ye qob uber aninob qemerib doroum. Qob eng munon gugum igub mismisirubour.
Itum et qas Debit wonou ginam end munon anubersieriba eng unor baiai, eng Munon aib. Qenu qoan ir inubersi qamb maribigor eng, unum Krais, eng Munon inubersiau tari.
Eng ye qob apand aninob quraum. An is gunon eng wau mingoant ouri wogub bur qarig tabin end inisiurei igama guboumon.”
Ende wurinob qamb igama qand enger yurau aib der eng nob erogori Qenut mismisir uru wab qamamir:

content.text: Qenu unum abari tubub aib iriner. Iroa munon ag oau mein burab igamari Qenu wurit igub igoriner.

content: 2:15-20 Munon sipsip qoat igour eng diab Yisas gamirei
Ende qamb wogub erer qite iroari wogub munon wai qoat igour eng der wurinou qob-qob qamamir: “Wagari qand Betlehem umo isub mi eng aba Munon aib ininob qura eng gun.”
Ende qamb qand isub Maria Yosep nob ibag wau mingoant ouri wogub bur qarig tabin end bigumirei igama gamirei.
Gab enger qob wurinob qamar eng gugum wuri nob qamamirei.
Qamarari wuri qob eng igub uberetemirei.
Maria qob eng gugum igub wogub mom misirt big qenen igub igoai.
Ne munon wai sipsip qoat igour eng bo isub enger qob qamara igumir eng ne mi gabriamir end Qenut uru wab mismisir igurei, enger wurinob qamar gas ende at igurei.
2:21 Yisas unum bigumirei
Ne inorou gari uma ne (wurinou qomon eng toat) wau git goan sirigum nob igoar qamb suab ne unum qoan unor qurag igama enger nob qamar eng, “Yisas” qamamirei.
2:22-38 Simeon Ana nob Yisas inorou munai aib mor end gamirei

Ende qamb wogub igoi inorou qei-qei uma ne Moses qomon qoan gumater eng gab unor wau bauor end Qenut mian isiari Pris munon inmaragansiar qamb Yerusalem qite iramirei. End irab wau qamar eng gor Qenu sirbigub qamb ebetemirei.
Eng Munon aib wonou qomon ete gumatemirei igo: “Munonbor wau qamar unor wuri baiari ibag eng Munon aib wonomi tetemi.”
Ombur iramir eng gor wau eng gab-gab mian iset Munon aibt qomon qura gas ende oboub qamb. Qomon eng ete igoai: “Morogan wamariau ombur qiyo qabturin yeim ombur ende mutet warar,” ende igoai.
Qen end munon ger Yerusalem end igoai, unum eng Simeon. Wo munon qoregen igo Qenut oabig qenen uru wab igoai. Wo munon ger Isrel wuriubersierib deriner end qoat igama Igomurur qau opurima ten igoai.
Eng wo Igomurur qau qo nob ete qamarei: “Me uminenei igo Munon aib wonou munon wuriubersieriner eng imurima dara gab wogub umiban,” qamar end qoat igoai.
Qen end Igomurur qau Simeon oau menima Qenu wonou munai Tempel eng mor isorei. Isub ibagar eng wau ur unor nob qomon igo eng taut wau Qenu sirbigub at igurei.
Ende gab wau ur ba igama ubent wot ba Qenu nob qamar:

content.text: Io Munon Aib, see nonou qob yet nausien eng mi irimanima gaum eng gab ye oau mom meinburoum. Umin eng qob ue.
Ye munon inubersieriner eng ge qamb yedua igoum eng qo yesirbiga gaum e.
End ne munon magqurt tap wurit arsia gunor.
Wo nonou urut begen gas ende. Munon yurau ar eng geari ne nonou munon yurau tetemi Isrel eng wuri unum deberi igoriba.

content: Simeon wau eng ba qob ende at qamara wau ur unor nob borusi qiet misir igub igurei.

Ende at igamari wuri gor wurinonogursi Maria nob qamar: “Wau e Qenu wonou maribigorei. End Isrel munon irou merimotoubar ne qei qob qamara igotoubour. Qenu wonou mi wes eng wau eng wo ba dibesia munon irou gab simbiri wab wogub wurinou misir boru dibesiorubour.
Ende at isi yarab wurinou misir qi igoriner eng wot abari gab ne borusi toubet eab-eab oau uri gegereteriban,” ende qamarei.

Yamangar ger Qenu qob wo nob qamara miteri qamb igoai, unum eng Ana. Ur unum eng Panuel, wo Aser tumbigi. Ana wo munon bauor eng togun 7-ende wara umami uma wogub wonou ar qindou igoi wogub sig isigi burerei.
Qindou igama togun bo 84-ende war eng wo Qenu bais me wagau, woromt itum qenen Qenu munai Tempel mor end isub wot simot eab ne qen qei-qei Munon aibt igib qamb mani gitab ende at igoai.
Wo gor qen end gari qeemben diab Qenut uber qamb ne wau end munon qei Qenu Yerusalem ubersierib qamara qoat igoar end wurinob qamarei.
2:39-40 Yosep bo Nasaret end isumirei
Qomon qoan igoar end mom toat sarau ende at ugab wogub bo Galili der wurinou ginam qenen Nasaret end isumirei.
Is end igamari wau baraiburab nonoguret ne qoyam gor aibtarei. Ende aba Qenu musub igoai.
2:41-52 Wau moi Yisas tempel mor isorei
End igo Yisas ur unor nob togun gugum qen aib, “Qenu tonoanb me igaramau” qamb mi at nub igour end ginam aib Yerusalem ite ir igurei.
Yisas igama igoi togun 12-ende wara ne bo ur unor nob togunt qenen ir igour gas ende bo Yisas mot iramirei.
Qen aib eng ubura ne ur unor bo ginamt isari Yisas Yerusalem qite igoar eng ur unor qoyam ue.
Wo, mai, gigi munon qei isour eng wurinob isai ende qamb ar isumirei. Isub wonou yurau banamori wurinob isai qamb gamir eng ue. Ende gab wot asi qib igamari qen gari uburerei.
Sig me gab wogub ne bo wot asi yonam Yerusalem qite iramirei.
Irab wot asi qib igamari qen ombur gari ubura is munai aib mor end gamir eng Yuda imbigau munon aib-aib qob qamarari igub wo bo wuri qebi qamb ende at igama gamirei.
Munon barai-barai wo qob qamara igub a wuri qebimari wo musub taui wurinob qamara wo qoyam aib eng gab qietemirei.
Ur unor nob ende gab qiet ne unor der nob qamar: “Ne meimet qamb qi ende iua igama in tain nob net asi qibi seretoroun.”
Ende qamara wo taui qamar: “An meimet qamb yet asi qib igoumon? Ye yonou tain munait igoum eng an qoyam ue e?”
Ende wurinob qamara wuri qob qanam sir me imbigau.
Ende oromar qamb wogub wurinob Nasaret qumo isub qob qamarari toat mi ebet igoai. Unor Yisas qob eng qamar eng igub ten igoai.
Yisas ende at igo ne git goan qoyam nob aib burerei. Ende aba munon gab qenungari Qenu gor gab qenungeterei.
